description: This file defines configuration options, types, and functions for OpenTelemetry gRPC instrumentation, including filters, propagators, span options, and event recording.

classes.name: config
classes.description: Holds configuration options for gRPC instrumentation, including filters, propagators, span options, and event flags.

methods.name: newConfig
methods.description: Creates a new config instance with provided options, initializing default propagator, tracer, and meter providers.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Method for Option interface; applies a configuration option to a config instance.
